leave_policy.title: Employee Leave Policy
leave_policy.summary: Rules governing annual leave allocations, application procedures, and approvals.

annual_entitlements.casual_leave: 12 days per calendar year (accrued at 1 day per month). Intended for personal matters and short leaves.
annual_entitlements.sick_leave: 10 days per calendar year. For personal medical needs. Medical certificate is mandatory for absences exceeding 2 consecutive days.
annual_entitlements.earned_leave: 15 days per calendar year. Available to employees with at least 6 months of continuous service. Can be carried forward up to 30 days.
annual_entitlements.unpaid_leave: Granted only under exceptional circumstances subject to department head and HR approval.

leave_policy.application_guidelines: Leave requests must be applied through the HR portal. Planned leaves require at least 3 business days advance notice. Unplanned medical leave must be intimated within 24 hours.
leave_policy.approval_workflow: Leaves are reviewed and approved by the immediate reporting manager and validated by Human Resources.

working_hours.title: Working Hours Policy
working_hours.summary: Standard daily and weekly working schedules for company employees.
working_hours.schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
working_hours.standard_daily_hours: 8 working hours (480 minutes) per day, excluding 1 hour lunch break.
working_hours.weekend: Saturday and Sunday are standard non-working weekly rest days.

attendance_rules.title: Attendance & Punctuality Rules
attendance_rules.summary: Policies regarding clock-in, late entry marks, and unexcused absences.
attendance_rules.start_time: 9:00 AM is the standard daily shift start time.
attendance_rules.grace_period: A 15-minute grace period is provided. Clocking in on or before 9:15 AM is considered on-time.
attendance_rules.late_entry: Clocking in after 9:15 AM is recorded as a Late Entry with late minutes tracked.
attendance_rules.late_entry_penalty: Accumulating 3 late entries within a single calendar month leads to a half-day leave or salary deduction.
attendance_rules.early_departure: Clocking out before 5:00 PM without supervisor authorization is logged as an unauthorized early exit.
attendance_rules.absence: Failure to report to work without prior notice or approved leave is marked as an unexcused absence (ABSENT) and subject to loss of pay.

overtime_policy.title: Overtime Policy
overtime_policy.summary: Guidelines for pre-authorization and compensation for overtime work.
overtime_policy.eligibility: Non-exempt and technical staff working beyond 9 hours (540 minutes) on a regular working day or performing critical duties on weekends/holidays.
overtime_policy.pre_approval: All overtime must be pre-approved in writing or via HR ticket by the reporting manager.
overtime_policy.compensation: Overtime is compensated either through hourly overtime pay as part of monthly payroll or as compensatory off (comp-off) upon manager agreement.
overtime_policy.overtime_records: Overtime is calculated to the exact minute based on electronic clock-in and clock-out timestamps.

holiday_rules.title: Public & National Holiday Rules
holiday_rules.summary: Company observed gazetted holidays and holiday work compensation.
holiday_rules.annual_entitlement: 10 paid public holidays per calendar year according to the published company holiday calendar.
holiday_rules.holiday_work: Employees required to work on a gazetted national holiday receive either double the regular daily wage or compensatory time off.
